pluss::subsp::stats::ts::PartitionWindow¶

One training/test window of a TsPartition.

PartitionWindow is plain data holding 0-based inclusive index ranges; a range with end < start is empty.

Fields¶

Field

Type

Default

Meaning

train_start, train_end

std::int64_t

0, −1

The training range.

test_start, test_end

std::int64_t

0, −1

The test range.

test_buffer_start, test_buffer_end

std::int64_t

0, −1

The buffer of max_lag observations before the test range (empty when max_lag = 0).

Guidance¶

train_size(), test_size() and test_buffer_size() return the lengths.
